title_original: Iraq Reopens and Invites You to Visit Its Museums
excerpt_original: The Iraq Museum in Baghdad and the Mosul Cultural Museum are set to reopen in the coming months, while multiple new museums have been announced across the country.

blocks.text: After a record-high 10 million tourists visited the country in 2025, Iraq has renewed its commitment to investing in its travel and tourism sectors through cultural institutions, heritage and archaeological sites, and religious attractions.

Ali al-Dakhili, the Iraqi Minister of Tourism and Antiquities, recently announced that the Iraq Museum in Baghdad will reopen this December, while three new museums are planned for the provinces of Nineveh, Diyala, and Diwaniyah. Al-Dakhili publicized the Ministry's intentions as Iraq inaugurated its first museum devoted to Iraqi-Jewish history at the recently renovated historic Shamash Jewish School in Baghdad late last month.
